items.content: This post is key. The cheaper AI gets, the more opportunity there is for the entire ecosystem - especially including end-customers - to benefit. Everything is bottlenecked by being able to successfully and cost effectively deploy AI in real workloads. Any time we can lower the cost of AI, the total usage goes up. items.content: Here’s another awesome use-case for what we can now do with our unstructured data because of AI agents. Box now works with Databricks so you can take structured data from enterprise content (like contracts, financial document, supply chain data) and connect that data into Databricks. This means that I can now query large document datasets without moving or reprocessing that content. And you can connect the data with any other system, like your ERP data, CRM, or product analytics.
